name: episodes_list
title: List episodes
description: Lists or finds top-level EPISODES, the unit of work: the front door for browse, latest/open, project recaps or coaching prep. `query` matches episode, project, recording, or speaker names across fields ("mike john" finds the Mike & John Show; "me" usually means the studio owner). Rows carry `match_reason`, a dense indexed description, and `episode_shape`/`latest_open_hint` separating ready full-length episodes from short drafts; `order:"latest"` sorts newest first for "latest episode" asks, and project-scoped lists default to chronological order for recaps. Returns row-carrying prose only, with each exact `episode_id` in brackets for the next tool call. Project content evidence comes from transcript_search windows; opening is workspace_open (focus_range focuses transiently without saving), and saved ranges are review_points_place. Raw recordings are a drawer (recordings_list); excludes render outputs and derived clips. Read-only.

project_id.description: Optional project public ID — scope the list to a single project's episodes.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive filter across episode title, project title, segment recording/source titles, and speaker names; it finds a named episode before a read.

order.description: Optional order: `latest` for newest-first latest/last/refresher tasks, or `chronological` for oldest-to-newest project recaps. Project-scoped default is chronological; account-wide default is latest.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of recent episodes to return ('last few' is 3 unless the user names another count).

input.query: Visual Analysis Prototype and Coaching Workflows

examples.label: Find latest session in a project
